authorization: Latest user-authorized parent instruction supersedes no-PPO-today; same original allocation only
target_rule: One all-one LoRA30-update reference per task, same root and stop examples; median stop CE at updates20/25/30. No policy-dependent target; no retuning if short or failed.
data_boundaries: Reuse preprocessed source-component splits and normalized exact/near-duplicate exclusions. Three train roots use first nine train tasks, two confirmation roots first six held-out confirmation tasks. No task overlap across these sets; source grouping relies on recorded preprocessing and cannot exclude unknown common web origins. Development root was already queried in pilot. Confirmation tasks were not used in controller training/selection; task inputs were included only in pre-score general decontamination audit. New order alone would not imply unseen tasks.

observation.ema: short alpha=.5, long alpha=.1; once per uncached decision boundary only. First observation initializes EMA to signal. Learning EMA reset at task boundary; route-risk and potential recovery EMA persist across history. Potential recovery uses previous observed potential minus current. Exact state copied in checkpoints.
observation.rule: same full observation and action interface; original potential/gap/short-learning base rule, correction risk=old-current usage + positive(short-long risk EMA); thresholds and tie rule unchanged. No feature or rule search.

ppo.root_order: balanced cyclic three roots, four maximum visits each; each visit restarts exact same root prefix and generates new actions/current-policy trajectory; learner outcomes after divergence never cached
ppo.admission: Only admit full pairs with remaining time > max(600,2*max(last3 completed rollout seconds)*1.25+30). Stop by time/count, never score. Stage end bounds active rollout via existing update-boundary checkpoint guard.
ppo.initialization: single seed, no clone. Shared base output zero weights and .90 prior on multiplier1/.025 each other; count output zero weights, probabilities .90/.05/.05 for 0/1/2 corrections; epsilon .02 valid-factor uniform mixture; other layers seeded initialization.
ppo.deployment: last completely optimized policy; frozen weights, greedy ordered latent choices; no checkpoint/seed/decoder search
ppo.optimization_accounting: Report complete per-root new rollout count, decisions, two-history batches, actual optimizer epochs/gradient steps separately

fixed_selection: Lexicographic failure_count, cumulative positive old-task CE forgetting, final mean CE, path updates on reused pilot development root; menu uniform1/static050 only. Best in menu, no global best claim.
development: Reuse existing pilot uniform1/static050 outcomes and reference target; EMA does not change deterministic fixed actions, learner batches or stopping. Rebuild shared prefix; new rule and final frozen PPO paths with task generation, no general scoring. No checkpoint selection beyond registered last policy.
confirmation: Two held-out roots, shared A prefix per root, same targets/stream; uniform1 plus selected static if distinct, same-information rule base1, selected frozen PPO. All task CE/EM/F1 triangular matrices and endpoint general scores. Preserve incomplete/failing paths, no reruns by result.
reward: Original endpoint-corrected potential shaping: -full retained old-monitor positive CE forgetting/.1 -3*failed_tasks, with cached initial potential offset. No isolated task eval/generation/confirmation/general metric in controller observations or reward.
general: Reuse fixed audited612 items and adapter-on initial score from pilot (already exposed engineering subsets, not fresh test). Independently score each confirmation endpoint, never selection. Raw NLL/accuracy/per-item paired changes.
cost: Training includes all monitor/replay/task-CE cost, omits generation scores not used by PPO. Development/confirmation include all task scores. General initial and development fixed/reference pilot costs explicitly reused, not billed again. Shared prefix actual execution counted once; logical path includes prefix per method. Include reset/copy, target generation, controller optimization, selection, confirmation, artifacts and wall time.
budget_estimate: Pilot target90 updates ~502s; common A20 ~158s including ~69s generation; branch fixed/rule ~389-427s includes ~40s general and ~180s generation. Training suppresses generation/general and reuses root prefixes, estimate ~200-250s per fresh branch plus 3 references/~300s prefixes. 12 is bounded upper target, actual admitted pairs depend only elapsed durations. 85/30/75min caps, 12:40 UTC ceiling take precedence.
